name: Franka Kitchen Manipulation Benchmark
description: A benchmark for goal-conditioned robotic manipulation in a simulated kitchen environment, where an agent must complete diverse object interaction tasks such as opening, moving, inserting, and turning appliances or utensils.
evaluation_method: success_rate, task completion rate, average return
notes: Often used to study long-horizon manipulation, generalization, and transfer in simulation. Task definitions and scoring can differ across benchmark variants.
